title: fix(plugin-security): the boot report's unnamed-grant line says what 18.0 supports for a v17 database
body:
Fixes #24652

Clause-②: no — basis: runtime log text only. The report's result, its structured meta, the log level, the scan and every other line are unchanged; no accept set, flag, exit code, export or stored shape moves.

The `domain:services` row of the 18.0 release-text family (parent #24637); claim `6277834047`. The boot report's unnamed-grant line told the operator to plan with `os migrate organization-ownership --out plan.json`, then run `os migrate organization-ownership --apply --backup-taken --plan-file plan.json`. 18.0 refuses that command on every database (`NOT_IMPLEMENTED`), so the line sent an operator to a refusal. It now says what 18.0 supports for a v17 database, in the sentence PR #24635 (`f89d29e382`) landed in the drop-gate refusal of `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` (the boot refusal and the command's own refusal say the same in their own terms), and names no step of the command.

## Before and after

`catalog-reference-report.ts`, the unnamed-grant line (the `unnamed.count` branch of `logReport`), the only line in the file that prescribed the command (a `git grep` of `organization-ownership`, `plan-file` and `plan.json` over `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src` at base finds no other line of this file that prescribes it; the other hits are code comments, plus one other file's warn string reported below).

Before (base `f89d29e382`):

```text
[security] N sys_user_permission_set grant(s) name no permission set (permission_set is empty), so each confers nothing (ADR-0131 D4). Nothing was changed. Fix: run the v18 ceremony. Plan it first, os migrate organization-ownership --out plan.json, and review the file it writes; then run os migrate organization-ownership --apply --backup-taken --plan-file plan.json, which executes that plan: it names each legacy grant from its retired id and lists the ones it cannot name. Then restart. Granting the set again by name before it runs makes a second grant the ceremony will report, not name.
```

After (head `cf2ef1953`), as the new pin reads it from the real `reportCatalogReferences` on a real engine with two unnamed grants (N = 2):

```text
[security] 2 sys_user_permission_set grant(s) name no permission set (permission_set is empty), so each confers nothing (ADR-0131 D4). Nothing was changed. 18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path.
```

Kept: the count, the field, the D4 reason, "Nothing was changed.". Dropped: the two command steps, the restart step, and the advice about granting the set again by name, which all described the 18.x ceremony that 18.0 does not carry. The structured meta (`count`, `organizations`), the `error` level and the report result are untouched.

## Pin

`catalog-reference-report.test.ts` gains one test, in its own `describe`: it boots the real `SecurityPlugin` on a real `ObjectQL` over SQLite, stores two unnamed grants beneath the engine, runs `reportCatalogReferences`, finds the line as the single `error` call (anti-vacuity: called once, `meta.count` is 2), and asserts the full line prefix plus the 18.0 sentence verbatim, that the line ends with that sentence, and that it matches none of `organization-ownership`, `os migrate`, `--out`, `--apply`, `--plan-file`, `--backup-taken`, `plan.json`, `ceremony`. The file header said "never the log's wording"; it now names this one pin as the exception, because the card asks for the text to be pinned and the release says one sentence about a v17 database everywhere.

## Evidence

- Reverse verification (at `2171d2657`, fix committed first, mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `src/` imported directly so no rebuild is owed): replacing `keep a v17 database on a 17.x release` in the source with `run os migrate organization-ownership --out plan.json, then --apply --plan-file plan.json` turns the pin red (`Tests  1 failed | 14 passed (15)`, the failure is the new test's `toContain`). Direction: red, as expected. The restore was proven on disk: blob `14fa2de80499` before and after, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- At the final head `cf2ef1953`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/catalog-reference-report.test.ts`: 15 passed (14 before this PR plus the new one). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: 188 files, 3755 passed, 45 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0, including `check:test-typecheck` (0 errors).
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 68 families at the final head `cf2ef1953`; all 68 were run and recorded with their exit codes (all 0); `--ran` reads `68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. On the first pass at `2171d2657` two (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`) exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `dist/` outside the plugin-security closure), so a full `turbo run build` was run (75 of 76 tasks cached) and the whole list was run again at `cf2ef1953`. The second commit changes a test comment and the changeset prose only.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface: the claim's three files only (the report, its test, `.changeset/24652-report-v18-upgrade-text.md`, `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-security`). No `packages/spec/**`, no CLI file.
- The report file's own docblock (lines 22–25) still says the v18 ceremony names every grant it can. It is a code comment, which the family's census excludes because no reader sees it, so it is left as is.
- The released `18.0.0-next.2` entries of `packages/plugins/plugin-security/CHANGELOG.md` (lines 346 and 484–493) still carry the old prescription. A released entry is amended in a dedicated docs-only PR, never here. Carrier: none.
- Found outside this PR's file surface, same family, not edited. Three runtime strings that send an operator to the refused command and that the family's census command does not match (none spells `--apply`, `--out` or `--plan-file` next to the command name), so none is a row of #24637:
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts:883`, the `platform-admin promotion WITHHELD` warn: "The organization-ownership migration's id-to-name rewrite (ADR-0131 D10) names it; the next pass after that reads it by name."
  - `packages/metadata-core/src/legacy-organization-row.ts:78`, `LegacyOrganizationRowsUnreadable` (`LEGACY_ORGANIZATION_ROWS_UNREADABLE`): "Run `os migrate organization-ownership` on this database first."
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts:1739`, the seed refusal for an unowned holder row: "Attribute the unowned rows first (`os migrate organization-ownership`, then the same command with --apply)".
  They are read from source, not run through a public door. They are named in the dev report for the seat to fold into the parent card #24637.
- `origin/main` moved 22 files since the base (`f89d29e382`), none under `plugin-security` or `.changeset/24652-*`; main was not merged in, the queue's rebuild covers it.
